news.bodyKey:
Thank you for following along with the development progress of Glam Rock TD!

Here's what's new:

THE VISUAL OVERHAUL IS COMPLETE: Every menu in the game has now been rebuilt with our new visual style, and panels, dialogues and counters move with brand new animations. This is the second and final part of the overhaul we started last update.

A NEW WAY TO START A LEVEL: Difficulty selection and dialogue replay now live in a single, redesigned level screen. Victory and defeat panels have been reworked too, and ratings are finally shown everywhere they should be.

MEET YOUR ENEMIES: The Bestiary is here, with a dedicated page for every enemy you'll face.

ENDLESS, REBALANCED: Endless mode has been completely rebalanced with a new wave composition and difficulty curve. Levels 2 to 5 got balance passes as well, and level 2 now features a shooting enemy.

ACCOUNTS AND PRIVACY: You can now delete your account and its data at any time from the profile panel, and account creation includes age verification and privacy policy acceptance. Offline play and login stability have been improved.

AUDIO: New music for level 1-4, updated FMOD banks and several sound fixes, including the mammoth pitch issue on speed change.

Thank you for your support!
